signal: EarthCam launched Control Center 9, its next-gen AI analytics SaaS platform for jobsite intelligence, with expanded Autodesk Construction Cloud integration.

email.body1:
Todd, saw EarthCam launch Control Center 9 with AI jobsite analytics and deeper Autodesk Construction Cloud integration.

A new SaaS platform usually opens more in-market construction accounts than a national team can personally reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for EarthCam off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Todd, quick follow-up for EarthCam.

After a platform launch, demand tends to outrun what a national team can cover. Most managers don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to capture it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EarthCam needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Todd, last bit of proof for EarthCam.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EarthCam's reply rate likely compares to peer construction-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Todd, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling national coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A platform launch keeps a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a construction-tech motion? I'll tailor it to EarthCam either way.
